description: "Pine Needles" by Susan Warner and Louis Harms is a fictional work written in the late 19th century. The narrative unfolds primarily around the experiences of the Franklin and Candlish families at Mosswood, as they navigate the joys of friendship and the beauty of nature, intertwined with deeper themes of faith and heroism.
